title: memcpy and memmove have different contracts for overlapping areas
summary: memmove behaves as if it copies via a temporary buffer. Overlapping source and destination ranges make memcpy undefined.
applies: C11; Offline memory diagnostics and object representation
detail: For ABCDE, move the first three bytes to the right by one space, and the canonical memmove result is AABCE. C11 §7.24.2.
boundary: Undefined behavior has no reliable fixed output. The presence of a reasonable string in a single run is not enough to establish cross-version expectations.
relevance: Determine the definite result of an in-situ move in the memory log.
